profile.intro: I'm a PhD student in Mathematics at Cheikh Anta Diop University, working in number theory with a focus on normal numbers.

research.intro: My research lies in number theory, with a particular focus on normal numbers, digit expansions and explicit constructions preserving normality properties.

topics.title: Normal numbers
topics.text: Normality and simple normality in integer bases, digit expansions, and constructions of numbers with prescribed normality properties.

topics.title: Number theory
topics.text: Problems concerning expansions of real numbers, distribution of digits, and related arithmetic questions.

publications.title: Construction of Numbers with the Same ‘Normality’ Properties as a Given Number
publications.journal: Springer Proceedings in Mathematics & Statistics, vol. 468, pp. 167–176
